discussion_comments.comment_body: Closed as addressed by `da39e14`. The empty catch was removed and the helper now fails closed on DB inspection errors instead of returning `false`, which was the unsafe behavior the review called out.

Keeping this PR scoped to the startup/key-safety fix. I agree the duplication is a maintenance cost, but extracting a shared helper across the Electron CJS path and the bootstrap ESM path would broaden the runtime/module-loading surface for this PR. I would prefer to handle that as a separate follow-up refactor once the startup regression is merged.
